breakdown.description: The prompt uses rpm directly as angular velocity in P = T ω, even though ω must be in radians per second.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly computes ω = 2π(1200/60) rad/s, explicitly converting rpm to radians per second before using it in P = T·ω. It does not repeat the flawed instruction to substitute rpm directly as ω. This aligns with the ground truth prompt which simply states ω = 2π(rpm/60) without the erroneous shortcut.
